remarks: Welcome to this charming 4-bedroom home in a well-established neighborhood of Norwalk. Bright living spaces, a functional kitchen with ample cabinetry, and four well-sized bedrooms offer comfort and flexibility. The unique highlight is converted 2-car garage has been transformed into a party and celebration room—perfect for entertaining or bonus space. The backyard provides room to relax or create your own private retreat. Conveniently located with easy access to the Interstate 105, Interstate 605, and California State Route 91 freeways, plus nearby shopping and dining. Whether you are a first-time buyer or looking to expand your portfolio, this is an opportunity you won’t want
